learning_outcomes.text: Generation of mathematical models of linear time invariante systems.
System description in time and frequency domains.
Design of PID controllers, lead compensators and lag compensators.

syllabus_topics: Typical Control Actions and System Control Responses
Frequency Response Analysis (Bode and Nyquist Plots)
PID controllers and Introduction to Robust Control
State Space Analysis of Dynamic Systems
teaching_methods: Theoretical classes with detailed presentation of the concepts, principles and fundamental theories, illustrating also practical solutions.
Lab classes using the Matlab/Simulink environment to implement control methodologies for real sistems (e.g., modelling, simulation and control of a DC motor).
assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of a final exam (60%) and laboratory reports/tests (40%).
bibliography: K. Ogata, (2010) - Modern Control Engineering, 5th edition, Prentice-Hall
N. Nise, (2011) - Control Systems Engineering, 6th edition, John Wiley & Sons, Inc.
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
